title: Foreign Students Learning Chinese in China
titleTranslate: 在中国学习的外国学生
text:
An increasing number of foreign students are learning Chinese in China.
What do they think about their language learning in China?
Here is an interview with some of them.

Leonardo: I am from Italy.
Some schools in my hometown have Chinese lessons.
We learn a lot of grammar, but we don't have many chances to speak Chinese.
Now in China, I'm learning more about Chinese history and culture, and I speak Chinese every day.

Emily: I am from America.
In my hometown, we only have two Chinese lessons each week.
It's not enough.
Here, I have Chinese lessons every day and speak Chinese all the time.
This experience helps me understand China much better.

Mira: I am from South Korea.
I am majoring in Chinese.
You know, teachers and students in my hometown speak Chinese with strong Korean accents.
The situation here is quite different.
Now I have some Chinese friends.
We chat with each other in Chinese.
I am doing my best to improve my Chinese pronunciation.

Reiko: Here in China, teachers teach us in Chinese.
However, in Japan, most classes are taught in Japanese, even Chinese classes.
The teachers here are friendly and helpful.
Now I am busy reading some Chinese classic works.
I am getting a deeper understanding of China.
textTranslate:
越来越多的外国学生正在中国学习汉语。
他们如何评价自己在中国的语言学习生活？
下面是对其中几位学生的采访。

莱昂纳多：我来自意大利。
我家乡的一些学校开设了汉语课程。
我们学了很多语法，但很少有机会说汉语。
如今在中国，我学习更多关于中国历史和文化的知识，而且每天都说汉语。

埃米莉：我来自美国。
在我的家乡，我们每周只上两节汉语课。
这还不够。
在这里，我每天都上汉语课，并且一直说汉语。
这段经历帮助我更好地了解了中国。

米拉：我来自韩国。
我主修汉语。
你知道，我的家乡的老师和学生说汉语时都带有浓重的韩国口音。
这里的情况大不相同。
现在我有了一些中国朋友。
我们用中文互相聊天。
我正尽力改善我的中文发音。

礼子：在中国，老师用中文给我们讲课。
然而在日本，大多数课程都是用日语讲授的，就连中文课也是如此。
这里的老师friendly而且乐于助人。
现在我正忙着阅读一些中文经典著作。
我对中国有了更深入的了解。

title: How do we feel about the weather?
text:
We're here at Mount Huangshan!
The clouds look amazing.
It feels like a magical place.
The trees and rocks look like a part of a painting.

Today I'm visiting Mount Huangshan with my family.
I'm not really enjoying the experience.
Everything looks grey, and you can't see much because of the heavy fog.
The ground is very wet, so we have to climb slowly.

We're at a rest area now.
Climbing is hard, but we're making good progress.
Although the weather is bad, many people here are still in high spirits.
I don't think my brother Peter is enjoying the experience very much, so I'm encouraging him.

The sun is shining through the clouds!
It's a lovely sight.
I'm so glad we're here at Bright Peak.

Climbing is tiring!
My shoes are all wet and dirty too.
There are many other tourists at this rest area, but they don't seem tired at all.
Instead, they're talking and laughing!
My sister Helen is also in high spirits.

We're here at Bright Peak.
Mount Huangshan is beautiful in the sunlight.
I'm tired and hungry, but it feels good to be at the top!

Good morning from Chengdu in Sichuan Province.
It's a cool spring morning in April.
It's raining heavily today, and the temperature is around 20°C.
Many people are staying in today.
It's a good day to do indoor activities.
But look behind me!
A few people are still outside.
They're hurrying towards the nearby buildings to hide from the rain.
It's important to carry an umbrella or pack a raincoat today.
textTranslate:
我们来到黄山了！
云海美极了。
这里感觉就像一个神奇的地方。
树木和岩石看起来就像画中的一部分。

今天我正和家人游览黄山。
我并不太享受这次游览。
一切看起来灰蒙蒙的，因为大雾弥漫，什么也看不清。
地面很湿，所以我们必须慢慢攀登。

尽管天气恶劣，这里的许多人仍然情绪高昂。
我觉得弟弟彼得并不太享受这次游览，所以我在鼓励他。

阳光正穿透云层！
这景色真美。
我们来到光明顶，我真是太高兴了。

登山真累！
我的鞋也都又湿又脏。
这个休息区还有许多其他游客，但他们似乎一点也不累。
相反，他们又说又笑！
我的姐姐海伦也情绪高昂。

我们来到光明顶了。
阳光下的黄山十分美丽。
我又累又饿，但站在山顶的感觉真好！

四川省成都向你道早安。
这是四月里一个凉爽的春晨。
今天大雨倾盆，气温约为20°C。
许多人都待在家里。
今天很适合进行室内活动。
但看看我身后！
还有少数人在外面。
他们正匆忙奔向附近的建筑物躲雨。
今天携带雨伞或穿雨衣很重要。

title: Zhu Kezhen and China's Weather Reports
text:
It is a bright sunny day and you're ready to go to school.
However, your mother tells you, "Take your umbrella.
It's going to rain this afternoon."

How does she know this?
From the weather report!
Thanks to Zhu Kezhen, a great Chinese meteorologist, we have a better understanding of the weather through weather reports.

Zhu Kezhen is the founder of modern meteorology in China.
He was interested in changes of nature from an early age.
In 1910, he went to the United States to study meteorology.
After he finished his studies there, he declined to teach in American universities and returned to China.
Thanks to his efforts, we Chinese were later able to have our own weather reports.

Zhu Kezhen made it a habit to observe the weather every day.
Rain or shine, Zhu got up early every day and walked outside with his diary in hand.
He observed the clouds and wind carefully and recorded them in his diary.
He kept recording his observations for over 50 years.
Even on the final day of his life, he recorded in the hospital, "Clear to cloudy, east wind 1–2."

Although Zhu passed away in 1974, he will never be forgotten.
His spirit will be remembered forever.
textTranslate:
阳光明媚，你准备好上学了。
然而，妈妈对你说：“带上你的雨伞。
今天下午要下雨了。”

她怎么知道这件事呢？
是从天气预报中知道的！
多亏了伟大的中国气象学家竺可桢，我们通过天气预报对天气有了更深入的了解。

竺可桢是中国现代气象学的奠基人。
他从小就对自然现象的变化感兴趣。
1910年，他前往美国学习气象学。
在那里学成后，他谢绝在美国大学任教，回到了中国。
由于他的努力，我们中国人后来才有了自己的天气预报。

竺可桢养成了每天观察天气的习惯。
无论晴雨，竺可桢每天总是早早起床，手里拿着日记本走到户外。
他仔细观察云和风，并把它们记录在日记中。
他坚持记录观察结果达50多年。
即使在生命的最后一天，他仍在医院里记录道：“晴转多云，东风1—2级。”

尽管竺可桢于1974年逝世，但人们将永远记住他。
他的精神将永远流传。

title: What did you learn on that special day?
titleTranslate: 在那个特别的日子里，你学到了什么？
text:
Today we went on a school trip to a farm!
It was tiring but great fun!
In the morning, we explored the farm.
There were large tents with tomatoes, cucumbers, and many other fruits and vegetables.
The farmer told us about how these fruits and vegetables go from the fields to our tables.
I was very interested because I usually only see them in the supermarket.

Then we got straight to work!
First, we picked some strawberries.
The work seemed easy, but it took time to get it right.
Slowly, we filled many baskets.
In the afternoon, the farmer taught us how to cut branches and leaves from tomato plants.
This helps them to grow more fruit.
Finally, we watered the plants.
Plants need so much work!
It was tiring, but I enjoyed working with my hands.

One thing I learnt today: Farming isn't easy!
It made me think of the saying,"Every grain comes from hard work."The farmer let us take some vegetables home.
My mum cooked some for dinner, and they were fresh and delicious!
They certainly taste better when you work for them!
Today was really a day to remember.
textTranslate:
今天我们去农场参加学校旅行！
虽然很累，但非常有趣！
上午，我们参观了农场。
那里有大的帐篷，里面种着西红柿、黄瓜以及许多其他水果和蔬菜。
农民给我们讲解了这些水果和蔬菜如何从田间运到我们的餐桌上。
我非常感兴趣，因为我通常只在超市里看到它们。

然后，我们立刻开始干活！
首先，我们摘了一些草莓。
这项活儿看起来很容易，但要做好却需要时间。
我们慢慢地装满了许多篮子。
下午，农民教我们如何剪掉番茄植株的枝叶。
这样有助于它们结出更多果实。
最后，我们给植物浇水。
种植植物需要付出这么多劳动！
虽然很累，但我享受亲手劳动的感觉。

今天我学到了一点： farming并不是一件容易的事！
这让我想到一句话：“每一粒粮食都来自辛勤劳动。”农民还让我们带了一些蔬菜回家。
我妈妈把一些蔬菜做成了晚餐的菜肴，它们又新鲜又美味！
亲手劳动得到的东西尝起来当然更香！
今天真是值得回忆的一天。

title: An Unforgettable Day of Zhang Guimei
text:
On 17 February, 2021, Zhang Guimei was awarded the Touching China Person of the Year title for her contributions to improving girls' education in remote rural areas.
Her love and care for her students deeply moved many Chinese.

Zhang Guimei is the highly respected founder and headmaster of Huaping Senior High School for Girls in Lijiang, Yunnan Province.
She was born in Heilongjiang Province in 1957.
At the age of 17, she moved to Yunnan to support the development of the country's border regions.
When working as a teacher at a local school, Zhang noticed that many girls were unable to go to school because they had to work and earn money to support their families.
To change this, she decided to set up a free high school for these girls.
Zhang worked hard to raise money and hire teachers.
In 2008, she founded China's first free senior high school for girls with government support.
Since then, the school has helped about 2,000 students to go to university.

"An educated girl can change the destiny of three generations in a family," Zhang said.
"An educated and responsible mother will never allow her daughter to drop out of school."
textTranslate:
2021年2月17日，张桂梅因她为改善偏远农村地区女孩教育作出的贡献，被授予“年度感动中国人物”称号。
她对学生的爱与关怀深深感动了许多中国人。

张桂梅是云南省丽江市华坪女子高级中学备受尊敬的创办人兼校长。
她于1957年出生在黑龙江省。
17岁时，她来到云南，支援国家边境地区的发展。
在当地学校任教时，张桂梅注意到，许多女孩因为需要工作并挣钱养家而无法上学。
为了改变这一状况，她决定为这些女孩创办一所免费高中。
张桂梅努力筹款并聘请教师。
2008年，在政府的支持下，她创办了中国第一所免费女子高中。
从那以后，这所学校已经帮助约2,000名学生进入大学。

张桂梅说：“一个受过教育的女孩能够改变一个家庭三代人的命运。”
“一位受过教育且有责任心的母亲绝不会允许女儿辍学。”

title: What can stories teach us?
text:
Once upon a time, there was a mother duck.
She had six little ducklings.
Five of the ducklings were small and yellow, but the last duckling was big and grey.
"He doesn't look like us!
What an ugly duckling!" the other ducklings said.
"That's not nice!" said Mother Duck.
"He's still a duck like us!"

In the river, the ugly duckling swam well, just like all the other ducklings.
But the other ducklings still laughed at him and told him to go away.
It made the poor duckling very sad, so he decided to search for a new home.
He met many other birds, but all of them thought that he was ugly too.
They did not want him to live with them.

One day, the duckling met a cat and a hen.
"May I stay with you?" he asked hopefully.
But the two animals said no.
They did not like him because he could not purr or lay eggs!

Some days later, the ugly duckling came to a lake.
There, he saw three beautiful swans with long necks and white feathers.
"I wish I looked like you!" he cried.
"My friend, you do look like us!
Look in the water!" one of the swans said.
The duckling looked down, and to his surprise, he saw that he was a beautiful white swan too!

Once upon a time, a fisherman caught a bottle in his fishing net.
When he opened it, a great cloud came out and became a genie!

"Prepare to die!" shouted the genie.
"A long time ago, I made a promise.
If someone set me free, I would make them rich and powerful.
But no one ever came.
After years and years of waiting, I became very angry.
If anyone set me free, I would kill them instead of giving them anything.
So, you must die!" . . .
textTranslate:
从前，有一只鸭妈妈。

多丑的小鸭啊！”其他小鸭子说道。
“这可不友好！”鸭子妈妈说。

在河里，丑小鸭游得很好，和其他所有小鸭子一样。

他遇到了许多其他鸟，但它们也都认为他很丑。

它们不喜欢他，因为他不会呼噜，也不会产卵！

几天后，丑小鸭来到一个湖边。
在那里，他看见了三只美丽的天鹅，它们有着修长的脖子和白色的羽毛。
“我真希望我长得像你们一样！”他喊道。
“我的朋友，你确实长得和我们一样！
看看水里！”其中一只天鹅说。
丑小鸭低头一看，惊讶地发现自己原来也是一只 beautiful 的白天鹅！

从前，一个渔夫在渔网中捞到一个瓶子。
他打开瓶子时，一团巨大的云飘了出来，变成了一个灯神！

“准备受死吧！”灯神喊道。
“很久以前，我许下过一个承诺。
如果有人放我出来，我就让他富有而强大。

等了千百年之后，我变得非常愤怒。

title: The Monkey King
text:
The Monkey King, also known as Sun Wukong, is a popular character both in China and around the world.
He is the main character in the famous Chinese novel Journey to the West.
He is not an ordinary monkey.
In fact, sometimes he doesn't even look like a monkey!
This is because he can change into 72 different forms, including different animals and objects.
To fight against evil, the Monkey King uses a magic stick.
He can make the stick so small that it fits in his ear, or make it so big and long that it can reach the sky.

The Monkey King's story has inspired Chinese children for a long time.
About 40 years ago, when a TV programme based on the story came out, children in other countries also became interested in the Monkey King.
They like the clever monkey because he always helps the weak and never gives up.
Everyone can learn valuable lessons from the story of the Monkey King.
textTranslate:
猴王，又称孙悟空，是中国和世界各地都家喻户晓的经典人物。
他是中国著名小说《西游记》的主角。
他不是一只普通的猴子。
事实上，有时他甚至看起来都不像猴子！
这是因为他能变成72种不同的形态，包括各种动物和物品。
为了与邪恶作斗争，猴王使用一根 magic 金箍棒。
他能让金箍棒变得很小，放进耳朵里；也能让它变得又大又长，直达天空。

猴王的故事激励中国儿童已有很长时间。
大约40年前，一部根据这个故事改编的电视节目播出后，其他国家的孩子们也对猴王产生了兴趣。
他们喜欢这只聪明的猴子，因为他总是帮助弱者，从不放弃。
每个人都能从猴王的故事中汲取宝贵的人生启示。

title: What can we learn from holiday experiences?
titleTranslate: 我们能从假期经历中学到什么？
text:
Today was our first day visiting Moscow.
The weather was fine and everyone felt excited to visit some famous places in Russia.

In the morning, we went to the Victory Museum.
The Russian people built this museum to remember their fight against the Nazis during World War II.
As we walked through the halls, the tour guide told us stories about the war.

In one hall, I saw an artwork with thousands of glass "tears" falling down.
It reminds us that war is terrible and peace does not come easily.
We should not forget that.

At noon, we had lunch at a restaurant near the park.
I liked the ice cream there, so I ate a lot of it.
But, during dinner, I didn't feel like eating because I felt sick.
So now, I just want to get a good night's sleep.

It rained last night, so this morning the air was fresh and cool.
I felt much better today.

We took the Moscow Metro to travel around.
The metro stations are really beautiful.
Sometimes I felt like I was walking inside a palace.
After that, we went to Red Square.
We saw some fantastic buildings there.

In the afternoon, we arrived at a school and met a group of Russian students.
We played games and soon became friends.
Later, someone took out his accordion, and soon everyone got together to sing and dance.
We were so happy that we didn't notice the time.
It was such a good experience!
Moscow Metro
textTranslate:
今天是我们游览莫斯科的第一天。
天气晴朗，大家都为能够游览俄罗斯的一些著名景点而感到兴奋。

上午，我们去了胜利博物馆。
俄罗斯人建造这座博物馆，是为了纪念他们在第二次世界大战期间抗击纳粹分子的斗争。
我们穿过展厅时，导游给我们讲述了有关战争的故事。

在一个展厅里，我看见一件艺术品，数千颗玻璃“泪滴”从上面落下。
它提醒我们，战争是可怕的，和平来之不易。
我们不应忘记这一点。

中午，我们在公园附近的一家餐厅吃了午饭。
我喜欢那里的冰淇淋，所以吃了很多。
但晚餐时，我因为感到不舒服，一点也不想吃东西。
所以现在，我只想好好睡上一觉。

昨晚下了雨，所以今天早晨的空气清新而凉爽。
今天我感觉好多了。

我们乘坐莫斯科地铁四处游览。
地铁站真的很漂亮。
有时，我觉得自己仿佛走进了一座宫殿。
之后，我们去了红场。
我们在那里看到了一些 fantastic 的建筑。

下午，我们来到一所学校，遇到了一群俄罗斯学生。
我们一起做游戏，很快就成了朋友。
后来，有人拿出了手风琴，很快大家都聚在一起唱歌跳舞。
我们太开心了，以至于没有注意到时间。
这真是一次美好的经历！
莫斯科地铁

title: The Chongyang Festival
text:
The Chongyang Festival is a traditional Chinese festival.
It falls on the ninth day of the ninth lunar month, so it is also known as the Double Ninth Festival.
This festival has been celebrated for over 2,000 years.
It is a day to enjoy the autumn weather and spend time with family members, especially the elderly.
Families usually invite their elderly members for festive meals, as Chongyang is a day to show respect for the aged.

During the Chongyang Festival, families often climb mountains or hills.
It is said that climbing to high places on this day can help keep diseases away.
After climbing, families usually enjoy a picnic.
The most important food is Chongyang cake (Chongyang gao).
It symbolizes a better life.
Traditional Chongyang dishes are different from place to place, but all are considered lucky foods for the holiday.

No matter how it is celebrated, Chongyang is a time for families to get together and enjoy the season.
Mountain climbing, family meals, and respect for the elderly all remind people of the importance of family.
textTranslate:
重阳节是中国的传统节日。
重阳节在农历九月初九，因此也称为“九九重阳节”。
这个节日已有两千多年的庆祝历史。
这是一个欣赏秋日景色、陪伴家人，尤其是陪伴老人的节日。
家人通常会请老人一起吃团圆饭，因为重阳节是一个尊敬老人、关爱老人的节日。

重阳节期间，人们常常去登山或爬坡。
据说，这一天登高可以驱病避灾。
登高之后，家人通常会一起野餐。
最重要的食物是重阳糕。
重阳糕象征着美好生活。
各地的传统重阳节食品各不相同，但都被视为节日的吉祥食物。

无论以何种方式庆祝，重阳节都是家人团聚、共度时光的节日。
登高、家人聚餐和尊敬老人，都提醒人们珍惜家庭。

title: What can you do for your home?
text:
Peter: Mum, | can I invite my friends | to our new house?
Mum: Sure, | Peter. || But we need to clean up first. || Would you like to mop the floor | or clean the windows?
Peter: I'd like to clean the windows.

Mum: Good job, | Peter! || The windows are really clean, | and they look like mirrors!

Peter: Dad, could you please give me a lift to the shop this afternoon?
Dad: Sorry, but I have to work from home all day.

Could I hang out with my friends after Sorry, Jim, but you have to pack up your lunch? things first.
textTranslate:
彼得：妈妈，我可以邀请朋友到我们的新家来吗？
妈妈：当然可以，彼得。不过我们得先打扫一下。你想拖地，还是擦窗户？
彼得：我想擦窗户。

妈妈：干得好，彼得！窗户擦得真干净，像镜子一样！

彼得：爸爸，今天下午您能送我去商店吗？
爸爸：抱歉，我今天一整天都要在家工作。

收拾好东西后，我能和朋友一起出去吗？——抱歉，吉姆，但你得先准备好午餐。

title: How do you feel at home?
text:
"It's almost the Spring Festival.
Can we go to Hainan for the holiday, Dad?"
"Not this time," Dad answered with a smile.
"We're going to your mum's hometown!"
Soon the day of our family trip came.
We got up very early in the morning to catch the train.
The train journey took more than five hours, and then we changed to a bus to get to my grandparents' village in the afternoon.
At the end of the road, I saw Grandpa and my little cousin standing in the cold wind waiting for us.
We walked quickly to greet them.
Grandpa helped us pull the heavy luggage into the house.
"Ah, home again!" said Mum with a smile on her face.
Grandma, my aunt, and my uncle were busy cooking dinner in the kitchen.
They were very happy to see us.
After a little while, my parents went to the kitchen to help.
"Could you bring Wenwen her favourite snacks?"
Grandma asked Grandpa.
I shared the snacks with my cousin and told Grandpa about school.
He was happy to hear I was doing well at school.
When dinner was ready, I asked, "Can I help?"
"You can set the table," Dad said.
We then enjoyed all the delicious food.
"Mm, the familiar taste of home!" said Mum.
During the dinner, my uncle told us some jokes and we had a good laugh.
Several days later when we were leaving, Grandma held my hands and asked us, "Will you come home more often?"
Mum nodded, with tears in her eyes.

It was fun to decorate your room last month.
I share a room with my brother, and with the coming of the Spring Festival, we want to decorate it to make a warm home.
Can you help us?

Right now, the walls are blue.
There are cute animals on them, but the animals look too childish for us.
We want to cover the animals and paint the walls with warm colours.
What do you think about the colour?

On Sunday, we can meet at the paint shop near the shopping centre and choose the paint together.
Then we can paint the room with my brother.
I loved the brushes we used for your room.
Can you bring them?

After painting, could you help choose some photos to hang on the walls?
Let me know what you think.
textTranslate:
春节快到了。
爸爸，假期我们可以去海南吗？
“这次不行。”爸爸微笑着回答。
“我们要去你妈妈的家乡！”
我们全家出行的日子很快到了。
那天早上，我们很早起床去赶火车。
火车旅程超过了五个小时，下午我们又换乘公共汽车，前往祖父母所在的村子。
在道路尽头，我看见爷爷和我的小表弟站在寒风中等着我们。
我们快步走上前迎接他们。
爷爷帮我们把沉重的行李搬进屋里。
“啊，又回家了！”妈妈笑着说。
奶奶、姑姑和叔叔正在厨房里忙着做晚饭。
见到我们，他们非常高兴。
过了一会儿，父母也去厨房帮忙。
“你能给温文拿她最喜欢的零食吗？”
奶奶问爷爷。
我和小表弟分享零食，还向爷爷讲起了学校里的事情。
听说我在学校表现很好，爷爷很高兴。
晚饭做好时，问道：“我能帮忙吗？”
“你可以摆餐具。”爸爸说。
然后，我们享用了所有美味的食物。
“嗯，还是家里熟悉的味道！”妈妈说。
吃饭时，叔叔给我们讲了些笑话，我们都笑了。
几天后，我们临行时，奶奶握着我的手问我们：“你们以后会常回家吗？”
妈妈点了点头，眼里闪着泪光。

上个月，给房间装饰很好玩。
我和弟弟共用一个房间。春节临近了，我们想装饰一下房间，让家变得温暖。
你能帮我们吗？

现在，墙壁是蓝色的。
墙上画着可爱的动物，但这些图案对我们来说太 childish 了。
我们想遮住这些动物，用温暖的色彩粉刷墙壁。
你觉得这个颜色怎么样？

星期天，我们可以在购物中心附近的油漆店见面，一起挑选油漆。
然后，我们可以和弟弟一起粉刷房间。
我很喜欢我们用来布置你房间的刷子。
你能把它们拿来吗？

粉刷完以后，你能帮忙挑选一些挂在墙上的照片吗？
告诉我你的想法。

title: Table Manners in China
text:
When dining in China, it is important to show proper table manners.
Here are some dos and don'ts to help you show respect while enjoying the dining experience.
textTranslate:
在中国用餐时，注意餐桌礼仪十分重要。

她正在电视上观看比赛。

title: How can we avoid getting hurt?
text:
It was a sunny day last Saturday.
Peter was excited to try out his new skateboard.
He got it as a birthday gift the other day.

After breakfast, Peter took his skateboard and helmet, and headed outside to the skatepark.
He put the skateboard on the ground and stepped on it.
With a push, he was off.
The wind brushed against his face as he picked up speed.
"This is fantastic!"
Peter shouted.

But suddenly, the skateboard hit a stone on the ground.
Peter lost his balance and fell forward.
He rolled over and over and finally came to a stop.

It took Peter a moment to catch his breath.
He felt a bit of pain on his left side.
Peter tried to stand up.
Luckily, he found that there was nothing seriously wrong with him.
The fall was scary, but thankfully, his helmet kept him safe.
Peter couldn't help but feel thankful to his mother, who always reminded him to wear a helmet when riding a bike or a skateboard.
After a short break, Peter took a deep breath and bravely stepped back onto his skateboard, ready to give it another try!
textTranslate:
上周六是个晴天。
彼得迫不及待地想试试他的新滑板。
前几天，他把这个滑板当作生日礼物收到了。

早餐后，彼得带上滑板和头盔，出门前往滑板公园。
他把滑板放在地上，踩了上去。
他用力一蹬，便滑了出去。
随着速度加快，微风掠过他的脸庞。
“太棒了！”
彼得大声喊道。

但突然，滑板撞到了地上的一块石头。
彼得失去平衡，向前摔去。
他翻了一个又一个跟头，最后停了下来。

彼得花了一会儿才喘过气来。
他感到左侧有些疼痛。
彼得试图站起来。
幸运的是，他发现自己没有受伤太严重。
这次摔倒很可怕，但幸好头盔保护了他，使他没有受伤。
彼得不禁感激母亲。她总是提醒他骑自行车或玩滑板时要戴头盔。
短暂休息后，彼得深吸一口气，勇敢地重新踏上滑板，准备再试一次！

title: China's School Bus Safety Policy
text:
In 2012, the Chinese government started a safety policy for school buses.
Thanks to this policy, more and more children, especially those living far from schools, can now travel to school more safely and conveniently.

For example, in Yantai, a city in Shandong Province, most village children used to walk several kilometres to school with their school bags.
Bad weather made the journey even longer and more difficult.

But now, because of the new policy, many children can take school buses to get to school.
Every morning and afternoon, big yellow buses travel through villages and communities, picking up and dropping off children.
This new policy has been warmly welcomed by both children and their parents.

Li Ming, a middle school student, used to get up very early in the morning and walk two kilometres to school.
Now, he can relax or even sleep for a while during the bus ride to and from school.
His mother no longer worries about him because he doesn't need to walk a long way in bad weather.

This policy not only reduces parents' worries but also helps lower their costs.
More and more parents appreciate the government's efforts to care for their children's safety.
textTranslate:
2012年，中国政府开始实施校车安全政策。
thanks to this policy... 多亏这项政策，越来越多儿童，尤其是住得离学校很远的孩子，如今可以更安全、更方便地往返学校。

例如，在山东省烟台市，过去大多数农村孩子都要背着书包步行几公里去上学。
恶劣天气使这段路程更加漫长和艰难。

但现在 owing new policy... 受益于这项新政策，许多孩子可以乘坐校车上学。
每天早晨和下午，大型黄色校车穿梭于各个村庄和社区，接送孩子上下学。
这项新政策得到了孩子和家长的热烈欢迎。

李明是一名中学生，过去每天早晨都要很早起床，步行两公里去上学。
现在，在乘车往返学校的途中，他可以放松一下，甚至睡上一会儿。
他的母亲不再为他担心，因为无论天气多么恶劣，他都不必长途步行。

这项政策不仅减轻了家长的担忧，也帮助降低了他们的开支。
越来越多的家长对政府为保障子女安全所做的努力表示赞赏。

title: Unit 2 · Weather and Mood
titleTranslate: 第2单元 · 天气与情绪
text:
Do you know how weather affects our lives?
Well, it affects where we go, what we do, and what we wear.
And it also affects how we feel and behave.
It is a big part of our lives!

We often use weather language to describe how we feel.
For example, if we are feeling ill, we say we are "under the weather".
If we are feeling stressed and busy, we can say that we are "snowed under".
We use "bad" weather (rainy, stormy, etc.) to describe a bad mood, and "good" weather (sunny, warm, etc.) to describe a good mood.

And that is not all.
The weather can even change the way we feel!
For example, sunlight helps our body to produce vitamin D.
This vitamin can improve our mood.
But some parts of the world get little sunlight in winter, so people can feel unusually sad then.
However, when it is hot and sunny, some people may get angry easily too!
Scientists are still studying how the weather changes the way people feel and behave.

These days, many of us spend less time outside than in the past.
Getting no fresh air or sunlight and spending too much time inside can make us feel down.
It is very important to go outside once in a while, whatever the weather, rain or shine!

Today was an amazing day.
There was a total solar eclipse in Wuhan!
I woke up early because I couldn't wait to see it!

My friends and I went down to the Yangtze River to find a good place to watch it.
We took cameras, chairs, food and drink, and special glasses so we could look at it.
Lots of people gathered there to watch too.
Slowly, the moon moved in front of the sun.
It looked like someone bit a hole in the sun!
It got darker and darker as the moon slowly covered the sun.

I was really inspired by the eclipse this morning.
In the afternoon, I spent hours reading about astronomers, eclipses, and how the planets move in our solar system.
The universe is simply amazing!
I also watched some videos with famous Chinese astronauts.
I want to become an astronaut or astronomer someday too.
The sky is the limit!
textTranslate:
你知道天气怎样影响我们的生活吗？
嗯，天气会影响我们的出行、活动以及衣着。
天气还会影响我们的情绪和行为。
天气是我们生活中很重要的一部分！

我们常用与天气有关的语言来描述自己的感受。
例如，当我们身体不适时，我们说自己“身体不舒服”。
当我们感到压力很大、非常忙碌时，可以说“忙得不可开交”。
我们用“坏天气”（下雨、暴风雨等）来形容坏心情，用“好天气”（晴朗、温暖等）来形容好心情。

这还不止于此。
天气甚至能改变我们的感受！
例如，阳光有助于人体产生维生素D。
这种维生素能改善我们的情绪。
然而，世界上有些地区冬季很少有阳光，因此人们那时可能会感到异常悲伤。
不过，当天气炎热晴朗时，有些人也可能很容易发脾气！
科学家仍在研究天气如何改变人们的感受和行为。

如今，我们中的许多人待在户外的时间比过去少了。
接触不到新鲜空气和阳光，以及在室内待得太久，都可能使我们情绪低落。
无论天气如何，无论下雨还是晴天，偶尔到户外走走都非常重要！

今天真是非同凡响的一天。
武汉出现了日全食！
我早早醒来，因为迫不及待地想亲眼看看它！

我和朋友们来到长江边，寻找观看日食的好地方。
我们带上了相机、椅子、食物和饮料，还有观看日食的专用眼镜。
也有许多人在那里观看。
渐渐地，月亮移到了太阳前面。
看起来就像有人把太阳咬出了一个洞！
随着月亮慢慢遮住太阳，天色越来越暗。

今天早上的日食让我深受鼓舞。
下午，我花了几个小时阅读有关天文学家、日食以及太阳系中行星运行的知识。
宇宙真是奇妙极了！
我还观看了一些中国著名航天员参与的视频。
我 someday 也想成为一名航天员或天文学家。
天空才是极限！

title: Unit 4 · The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
titleTranslate: 第4单元 · 渔夫和金鱼
text:
Narrator: There was once a fisherman who lived in a small house by the sea with his wife.
One day, something very special happened.
textTranslate:
旁白：从前，有一位渔夫和妻子住在海边一间小屋子里。
一天，一件非常特别的事情发生了。

title: Unit 5 · Holiday Experiences
text:
My best holiday experience was two years ago.
My family lives in Wuhan, the biggest city in Central China.
That summer, I decided to do something cool: cycling from Wuhan to Beijing with some friends from college.
My parents were surprised at my idea, but soon they gave me all their support.
With their help, I made a cycling plan.
I also learnt a lot from other people's cycling experiences.
I packed everything I needed and started the trip.
The cycling took us almost a month to complete.
It was tiring but worthwhile.
I saw beautiful mountains, forests, and rivers.
I met a lot of nice people, and some of them gave me a lot of help along the way.
But there were also difficulties, and sometimes I just wanted to give up.
However, when I finally arrived at the Tian'anmen Square, I was so proud of myself.

My best holiday experience was when I learnt to scuba dive.
My family and I went to a town beside the ocean.
At first, I took some classes to learn how to scuba dive safely.
I practised in a swimming pool for a few days.
Then, I lived on a boat for a week in order to do scuba diving in the ocean.
Every day, I went scuba diving with a guide.
I saw so many colourful fish, amazing sea animals, and fantastic coral everywhere.
While I was diving, another diver pointed, and I realized there was a baby shark near me.
It was a stunning experience, and I will never forget it!
textTranslate:
我最美好的假期经历发生在两年前。
我家住在华中最大的城市武汉。
那个夏天，我决定做一件很酷的事：和几位大学朋友一起骑车从武汉前往北京。
父母对我的想法感到惊讶，但很快他们便全力支持我。
在他们的帮助下，我制定了一份骑行计划。
我还从别人的骑行经历中学到了很多。
我收拾好所有需要的东西，出发了。
这次骑行几乎花了我们一个月。
虽然十分疲惫，但很值得。
我看到了秀丽的群山、森林和河流。
我遇到了许多友善的人，其中一些人在旅途中给了我很大帮助。
但旅途中也有困难，有时我只想放弃。
然而，当我终于到达天安门广场时，我为自己感到无比自豪。

我最美好的假期经历是学会水肺潜水的时候。
我和家人来到了海边的一个小镇。
起初，我上了几节课，学习如何安全地进行水肺潜水。
我在游泳池里练习了几天。
随后，我在船上住了一个星期，以便在海洋中水肺潜水。
每天，我都在潜水向导的带领下进行水肺潜水。
我看到了许许多多色彩斑斓的鱼、奇妙的海洋动物和美丽的珊瑚。
我正在潜水时，另一名潜水员指了指，我这才意识到附近有一条幼鲨。
这是一次令人惊叹的经历，我永远不会忘记！

title: Unit 6 · Anne's Decision
titleTranslate: 第6单元 · 安妮的决定
text:
Anne came back and found Marilla sitting by the kitchen table.
She looked tired.
"Are you OK, Marilla?"
"I saw the doctor," Marilla said sadly.
"But it's no good talking about it, Anne.
Can you get me a cup of tea?"
"Could you tell me what the doctor said?"
Anne asked softly as she brought tea to Marilla.
"He said I must give up all reading, sewing, and farming, or I will go blind."
"Marilla, don't think of it," said Anne.
"There is still hope."
"I don't know," said Marilla.
"I'm afraid I have to sell Green Gables."
Anne was surprised.
"Oh, Marilla, you can't!
It's our home!"
"What else can I do, Anne?
I'm sorry you won't have a home to come to during your university holidays."
Marilla began to cry.
That night, Anne sat in the darkness, alone with her tears and heavy heart.
But before long, there was a smile on her lips and peace in her heart.
The next day, she spoke with Marilla.
"You mustn't sell Green Gables.
I'm going to teach here.
I can't leave you alone, Marilla.
I'll read to you.
We'll be happy together."
"Oh, Anne, you can't do that for me."
"But I want to!
Nothing is worse than giving up our home."
"But your dreams ..."
"My dreams are the same: to be a good teacher, and to help you stay healthy.
Nobody loves Green Gables as we do.
We must keep it."
Most people, not knowing about Marilla's eyes, thought Anne was foolish.
Mrs Lynde, their neighbour, did not.
She often found Anne and Marilla sitting outside their home.
They liked sitting there at dusk, when the smell of flowers filled the air.
textTranslate:
安妮回来时，发现玛丽拉坐在厨房的桌旁。
她看上去很疲惫。
你还好吗，玛丽拉？
我去看过医生了，玛丽拉伤心地说。
但谈论这些也没有用，安妮。
你能给我倒杯茶吗？
你能告诉我医生说了什么吗？
安妮轻声问道，同时把茶端到玛丽拉面前。
他说我必须放弃阅读、缝纫和务农，否则就会失明。
玛丽拉，别想这些了，安妮说。
希望仍然存在。
我不知道，玛丽拉说。
恐怕我只能把绿房子卖掉了。
安妮很吃惊。
哦，玛丽拉，你不能这样！
那是我们的家！
我还能怎么办，安妮？
对不起，你以后在大学假期时就 没有家可以回来了。
玛丽拉哭了起来。
那天夜里，安妮独自坐在黑暗中，泪流满面，心情沉重。
但没过多久，她的嘴角便露出微笑，心中也恢复了平静。
第二天，她和玛丽拉谈了话。
你不能卖掉绿房子。
我要在这里教书。
玛丽拉，我不能把你一个人留在这里。
我会给你读书。
我们会一起过得快乐。
哦，安妮，你不能那样为我牺牲。
可是我想这样做！
没有什么比放弃我们的家更糟糕。
可是你的梦想……
我的梦想也一样：成为一名好老师，并帮助你保持健康。
没有人像我们这样爱绿房子。
我们必须保住它。
大多数人不知道玛丽拉眼睛的情况，都觉得安妮很傻。
她们的邻居林德太太却不这样认为。
她经常看到安妮和玛丽拉坐在屋外。
黄昏时，她们喜欢坐在那里，空气中飘着花香。
